title: sideritis libanotica subsp. linearis
intro: Sideritis libanotica subsp. linearis, commonly known as East Anatolian Ironwort, is a plant species within the Lamiaceae family, native to the mountainous regions of Eastern Anatolia in Turkey. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include a range of health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, as well as its potential to lower blood pressure and improve digestion. The therapeutic actions of East Anatolian Ironwort are attributed to its ability to relax muscles, improve sleep quality, and reduce stress levels. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
